OWNER_EMAIL.description: Email used to sign in as the installation owner. Configure Cloudflare Access after deployment.

CF_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Account ID for this installation, from the Cloudflare dashboard. Use the same account as the build token.

CF_API_TOKEN.description: Temporary domain setup token. This is separate from the Workers Builds deployment token. See https://boxox.dev/docs/deploy-button/.

AGENT_JWT_SECRET.description: Signs agent credentials only. Generate with openssl rand -base64 32 and keep it stable across deployments.

BOXOX_SIGNING_SECRET.description: Root for every other key: signed links and images in mail, tracking, download links, sealed tokens. Generate a different value with openssl rand -base64 32 and keep it stable across deployments.
